prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image: original Minecraft Fire Staff adventurer. Create a production-ready TRANSPARENT ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET of this SAME full-body character casting fire magic. Exactly EIGHT frames in a precise 4 columns by 2 rows grid, each cell equal width and height, no gutters, no drawn grid lines, no labels. Canvas 2048x1536, eight 512x768 portrait cells. Each cell uses the same camera, same character scale, the same ground baseline at 91% of cell height, same brown hair, dark green coat, brown gloves boots belt, and the same orange three-prong fire staff. Three-quarter rear view, facing screen RIGHT, same as reference. Keep whole body and whole staff inside EACH cell with 8% padding. Transparent RGBA background, no ground plane, no scenery, no text. The motion must be real body articulation, NOT a rotated or tilted cutout: knees bend, torso turns, elbow changes angle, left hand comes toward grip, staff lifts and thrusts with the right arm. READ frames LEFT TO RIGHT, top row then bottom row: 1 neutral ready stance, staff low and pointed diagonally forward to right; 2 anticipation, slight knee bend and hands pulling staff inward; 3 weight gathers over rear foot, right elbow bent and staff lifting; 4 body straightens with right arm lifting staff high; 5 strong overhead casting pose, staff nearly vertical, eyes toward target; 6 release with right arm extending forward and left arm balancing, torso leans into cast; 7 follow-through with lowered elbow and settling knees; 8 returns close to frame 1, staff back low at ready. Character ground anchors and identity consistent across frames. Crisp cubic Minecraft geometry and pixel texture with subtle shader lighting, matching reference. Small bright ember in staff crown only; no extra fire, no magic rays, no trails, no large diffuse glow. Even consistent contact baseline and camera throughout. This is one sprite sheet, not a montage.
processing: scripts/build-firestorm-poses.mjs selects six full-body poses and aligns their boot baseline; 400 × 600 delivery frames are upscaled from 362 × 543 source cells.
